trigger_summary: The staging directory is swapped via shutil.rmtree(target_dir) followed by os.replace(tmp_dir, target_dir), leaving a window in which the staging directory does not exist at all, so observers see neither the complete previous nor the complete new file set, violating the spec's atomic-replacement guarantee.
